name: theme-revolut-dna
docs: FONTS (required): add to your HTML <head> — CSS @import breaks Vite/lightningcss. <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Gantari:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">. Then wrap your app root in class="theme-revolut-dna" (add sf-enforce if the app bakes font/shadow literals). BACKDROPS: add one class beside the theme class for a wallpaper behind the glass — rv-glow | rv-lights | rv-abstract | rv-lava | rv-velvet | rv-travertine.
title: Revolut DNA
description: Revolut DNA — midnight fintech, aurora gradient accents, borderless — fonts via <link> (see docs), full app-variable bridge (shadcn + sidebar + charts + font/shadow scales). Wrap your app root in class "theme-revolut-dna".
